about.title: One clinic, every generation of your family
body: Shalom Family Clinic was started with a simple idea — a neighbourhood clinic in Madhanandapuram where you don't have to explain your history every single visit, because your doctor already knows it.

We see patients of every age under one roof, from routine child vaccinations to ongoing management of diabetes and blood pressure for grandparents. Evening hours mean you don't have to take time off work to see a doctor.
No long waits, no rushed five-minute consultations — just a clinic that treats you like family, because in a neighbourhood this size, you probably already are.

blogPosts.title: Building a Relationship With a Family Doctor: Why It Matters
blogPosts.excerpt: Seeing the same doctor over time changes the quality of your care — here's why continuity matters more than most people realize.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Arvind Raman
content: When you see a different doctor every time you're unwell, each visit starts from zero — a fresh history, a fresh set of guesses. A family doctor who knows your history skips straight to what matters.
Continuity of care isn't just convenient — it changes outcomes. A doctor who has tracked your blood pressure over two years will notice a subtle trend that a one-off visit would miss entirely.
This matters even more for children, where growth and development are best understood as a pattern over time rather than a single snapshot.

Building this relationship doesn't require anything dramatic — it starts with choosing one clinic for routine care and sticking with it, so your doctor has the fuller picture the next time something comes up.
